text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...! This... heat is surging up inside 
me...?!"

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
“It's so... warm... It feels as though 
someone is protecting me—”

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...No, of course not. On the path I walk, 
I need no one else's help."

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...Ngh. It doesn't matter, whatever it 
is. Even if it's borrowed power... I'll 
turn it into my own fuel with these legs."
